summary: Updated the Mangione record after the defense filed its October 30 reply seeking dismissal of the remaining New York murder and weapons charges under state double-jeopardy law; the motion remains undecided and the assessment is unchanged.

Updated the Quentin Deranque record after anti-terrorism police questioned Jeune Garde cofounder and LFI lawmaker Raphaël Arnault in a voluntary interview, while making explicit that reporting did not identify him as charged and that questioning does not establish command or culpability.

Updated the Charlie Kirk case after the October 23 scheduling hearing ended without a trial date and the court set a November 9 hearing to rule on the competing proposed timelines; the assessment and dimensional findings remain unchanged.

Updated the Kyle Wagner record after the Supreme Court denied his application to stay the Sixth Circuit mandate, while preserving the distinction between pretrial detention and adjudication of the pending charges.
Updated the Mangione record after Manhattan prosecutors filed their opposition to the pending state double-jeopardy dismissal motion; the assessment and dimensional findings remain unchanged.

Added dimensional assessments, per-record review dates, structured source provenance, explicit sampling limits, a public corrections log, validation gates, and daily monitoring. Updated active cases and policy actions through October 7, 2026.
